That reallocation spills into discretionary venues, so RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean exceeds its prior-28-day mean of -37.4.

fact:RETAIL_REC 4-week mean is -37.4 with t-0w the highest at -35.7
regime_hint: steady state with gradual behavioral reopening
failure_condition: The next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is less than or equal to -37.4 despite PARKS holding a weekly mean at or above +10.0 in the final two windows.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL above its baseline measures the share of activity still displaced into the home. When the RESIDENTIAL weekly mean crosses below +6.5, the residual home-confinement constraint has weakened enough that discretionary trips resume, lifting RETAIL_REC over the following two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Retail-and-recreation recovery requires two commuting anchors to move together: workplaces must refill and transit must carry them. TRANSIT (-31.6 to -30.0) and WORKPLACES (-39.0 to -39.6) are near-stationary, so co-crossing of TRANSIT above -30.0 and WORKPLACES above -39.0 is the only configuration that produces durable retail footfall over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean rises above -30.0 in the same window that WORKPLACES weekly mean rises above -39.0
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -31.6 (t-3w) to -30.0 (t-0w) while WORKPLACES worsened from -39.0 to -39.6
fact:the co-crossing condition has not yet held in any of the four windows
regime_hint: partial return-to-office with suppressed transit ridership
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean stays at or below -37.4 even after both TRANSIT exceeds -30.0 and WORKPLACES exceeds -39.0 in the same weekly window.

mechanism_narrative: The series is in a suppression plateau: RETAIL_REC has oscillated in a -38.9 to -35.7 band for four weeks with no reopening impulse, so the 28-day forward mean is pinned near the trailing mean of -37.4 with slight upward drift from the t-0w high of -35.7. Direction is therefore weakly positive, not a recovery breakout.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC range over the four windows is -38.9 to -35.7, a 3.2-point band
fact:RESIDENTIAL range is 6.0 to 7.4, also a narrow plateau
regime_hint: persistent pandemic-era suppression plateau with no reopening impulse
failure_condition: The next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC differs from -37.4 by more than 3.0 points in absolute value, which would falsify the plateau-and-drift claim.

mechanism_narrative: Under a constrained out-of-home trip budget, recovering essential trips crowd out discretionary ones. GROCERY_PHARM improved 4.7 points (-27.1 to -22.4) while RETAIL_REC improved only 3.2 points, leaving a 13.3-point gap; that gap marks substitution of the marginal trip toward essentials, so RETAIL_REC's forward 14-day mean falls relative to its trailing mean.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM weekly mean exceeds RETAIL_REC weekly mean by more than 12.0 points
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM minus RETAIL_REC gap widened to 13.3 points at t-0w
regime_hint: constrained out-of-home trip budget with essential-goods priority
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's next-14-day mean rises above its prior-14-day mean of approximately -36.9 while the GROCERY_PHARM minus RETAIL_REC gap remains wider than 12.0 points.

Without that base, RETAIL_REC cannot gain in the next week and slips below its trailing mean.
